Changelog

blogscapes (development version)

  • All package errors, warnings, and messages now use {cli} for clearer, more consistent formatting (#27).
  • crosspost_blog()’s returned targets now also includes the post’s source repo (named "source"), not just its destination copies, so [open_crosspost_prs()] also branches/commits/pushes/opens a PR there – the post is new in its source repo too and needs the same treatment (#55).
  • crosspost_blog() now copies only a post’s source content – its .qmd/.Rmd, referenced images, and references.bib if present – instead of the whole post folder, so Quarto render output left behind from a local preview (.html, *_files/, .quarto/, site_libs/) is no longer crossposted (#50).
  • google_doc_to_qmd() now resolves authors’ names and ORCIDs from the Openscapes team’s authors/ORCID Google Sheet instead of a CSV bundled in the package, so new authors can be added without a package rebuild. A new authors_sheet argument lets this be overridden (#20).
  • google_doc_to_qmd()’s Authors: field now accepts either an author’s short alias or their full name, matching whichever is on file in the authors sheet (#43).
  • google_doc_to_qmd() now strips base64 data: URI images from the post body (e.g. emoji pasted from Slack, which Google Docs exports as inline images), replacing them with their plain alt text instead of carrying the embedded image data into the generated .qmd (#49).
  • open_crosspost_prs()’s branch argument is now optional, defaulting to "crosspost-<post folder name>" derived from targets instead of requiring it to be retyped (and kept in sync) by hand (#52).
  • open_crosspost_prs() no longer fails to stage a target’s files when a path component resolves through a symlink (e.g. /var -> /private/var on macOS), which previously produced a “No staged files to commit” error (#52).
  • open_crosspost_prs() now attempts every target independently instead of stopping at the first failure – a problem with one destination repo no longer prevents branches/PRs from being created for the others. If any targets fail, one error lists all of them after every target has been attempted (#54).
  • verify_post_images() and crosspost_blog() no longer double-count or double-copy an image that’s referenced more than once in a post (e.g. used as both the cover image and an inline figure) – previously this made crosspost_blog() fail with an EEXIST error trying to copy the same file twice (#61).
  • verify_post_images() now reports success with a message naming how many images were checked, instead of returning silently (#46).

Developed by Ronny A. Hernandez Mora.

Site built with pkgdown 2.2.1.
